curl -s -XPOST localhost:3917/api/cart/quote -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"lines":[{"slug":"notebook","qty":3},{"slug":"eraser","qty":1}],"code":"save10"}'; echo
ID=$(echo "$R" | sed -E 's/.*"id":"([^"]+)".*/\1/'); curl -s localhost:3917/api/orders/$ID; echo

curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' localhost:3917/api/orders/nope; kill %1
